Committee: Finance and Taxation Education
Sponsor: Butler
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 03/07/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 290 as introduced would 1) reduce the minimum Business Privilege Tax (BPT) due for tax year 2023 from $100 to $50, and 2) eliminate the minimum BPT due beginning with tax year 2024 and thereafter. These provisions would reduce receipts to the State General Fund by an estimated $11.5 million in Fiscal Year 2023 and $23 million in Fiscal Year 2024 and each fiscal year thereafter.
Arthur Orr, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation Education

FISCAL NOTE

These provisions would reduce receipts to the State General Fund by an estimated $11.5 million in Fiscal Year 2023 and $23 million in Fiscal Year 2024 and each fiscal year thereafter.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund
